content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Public Policy, Sociology or a related quantitative discipline, with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA; Proficiency in Stata, R, SPSS or Python, including descriptive, bivariate and multivariate analysis Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in analysing large-scale survey or administrative data Other conditions: Proficiency in Stata, R, SPSS or Python, including descriptive, bivariate and multivariate analysis Desirable: Master's or higher degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Public Policy, Sociology or a related quantitative discipline, with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA Experience with digital data collection platforms (CAPI, KoBoToolbox or SurveyCTO), data cleaning and quality checks Familiarity with constructing composite indices; experience with judicial datasets such as NJDG is an advantage Understanding of research ethics, data protection and secure data management; good written English for reporting
